commands.name: New-OfficeMarkdown
commands.synopsis: Creates a Markdown file, optionally from a content block of Markdown DSL commands.
commands.notes: Content set: -Path is required, the block runs and the file is saved (FileInfo with -PassThru). Live set: no block, -Path optional; returns the live MarkdownDocument for Save-OfficeMarkdown [-Path]. Refuses an existing file unless -Force. Markdown has no theme, so no -Theme.

commands.name: Open-OfficeMarkdown
commands.synopsis: Opens a Markdown file or parses Markdown text into a MarkdownDocument, optionally editing it in a content block.
commands.notes: Path/LiteralPath with a content block saves back to the file when the block ends. The Text set only parses and returns the document (no file to save).

commands.name: Save-OfficeMarkdown
commands.synopsis: Saves a MarkdownDocument to its original path or to a new path.
commands.notes: -Path is optional; without it the document is saved to the path it was created or opened with. -PassThru returns the FileInfo.

commands.name: Close-OfficeMarkdown
commands.synopsis: Releases a MarkdownDocument opened without a content block, without saving.
commands.notes: Lifecycle parity with every authoring format. MarkdownDocument holds no file handle, so this only ends the document's DSL scope.

commands.name: New-OfficeMarkdownReaderOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Markdown reader options (dialect profile, URL policy, input limits) for Open-OfficeMarkdown, the Markdown readers and conversions.
commands.notes: Collects the reader parameters that were repeated on Get-OfficeMarkdown, Get-OfficeMarkdownFrontMatter/Heading/Node/Table and ConvertTo-OfficeMarkdownHtml.

commands.name: New-OfficeMarkdownHtmlOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Markdown-to-HTML options for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Html.
commands.notes: Carries every HTML rendering parameter of the former ConvertTo-OfficeMarkdownHtml. -Theme takes the shared OfficeTheme (replaces OfficeVisualThemeKind).

commands.name: New-OfficeHtmlMarkdownOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates HTML-to-Markdown options for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Markdown.
commands.notes: Carries every conversion parameter of the former ConvertFrom-OfficeMarkdownHtml, including the Markdown writer settings. -Options copies and adjusts an existing options object.

commands.name: New-OfficeMarkdownPdfOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Markdown-to-PDF options for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Pdf.
commands.notes: Defaults that are on (default theme, base-directory image restriction, front-matter theme and metadata, first heading as title, outline) are turned off with -No switches. IncludeLocalImages/IncludeDataUriImages stay opt-in resource-policy switches.

commands.name: New-OfficeMarkdownRtfOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates Markdown-to-RTF options for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Rtf.
commands.notes: Carries the Markdown-specific setting of the former ConvertTo-OfficeRtf -Markdown/-MarkdownPath sets.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownHeading
commands.synopsis: Adds a heading (levels 1-6).
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. -Text is now position 0 and -Level (default 1) is named, matching WordHeading/PdfHeading: MarkdownHeading 'Summary' -Level 2.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownParagraph
commands.synopsis: Adds a paragraph from text or from MarkdownText runs in a content block.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. The content block takes MarkdownText children for styled runs.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownText
commands.synopsis: Adds a styled inline run to the enclosing Markdown paragraph or list item.
commands.notes: Shared Text vocabulary (-Text -Bold -Italic -Strikethrough -Link). Markdown has no underline, color, font or size, so -Underline/-Color/-Font/-Size are not offered; -Code (inline code span) is Markdown-specific. Valid only inside a MarkdownParagraph or MarkdownListItem block.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownList
commands.synopsis: Adds a bulleted or numbered list from strings or from MarkdownListItem children.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. -Items stays as the one-line form; the content block form takes MarkdownListItem children (styled items, nested lists).

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownListItem
commands.synopsis: Adds an item to the enclosing MarkdownList from text or a content block.
commands.notes: Shared List/ListItem vocabulary: a list item takes -Text or a content block (MarkdownText runs, a nested MarkdownList).

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownTaskList
commands.synopsis: Adds a GitHub-style task list with checked and unchecked items.

parameters.name: Completed
parameters.notes: 1-based item positions.

parameters.name: Completed
parameters.notes: 1-based item positions.

commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. -Completed positions are 1-based (were 0-based).

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownTable
commands.synopsis: Adds a table from objects; columns come from their properties.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. -InputObject enumerates arrays as rows.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownImage
commands.synopsis: Adds an image reference.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.notes: Image path or URL written into the Markdown; not resolved or read.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.notes: Image path or URL written into the Markdown; not resolved or read.

commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. Width/Height take lengths and are written as CSS pixels; a bare number now means points (use 200px for the former behavior).

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownCode
commands.synopsis: Adds a fenced code block.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. -Content (a string) is renamed -Text so that -Content always means a script block across the DSL.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownCallout
commands.synopsis: Adds a callout (admonition) block such as NOTE, TIP or WARNING.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. -Body renamed -Text (shared vocabulary for block text).

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownQuote
commands.synopsis: Adds a block quote.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownDetails
commands.synopsis: Adds a collapsible details/summary block whose body is a content block.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownDefinitionList
commands.synopsis: Adds a definition list from term/definition pairs.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. -Definition accepts any dictionary, so [ordered]@{} keeps term order.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownFrontMatter
commands.synopsis: Adds YAML front matter from an object or dictionary.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownHorizontalRule
commands.synopsis: Adds a horizontal rule.
commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess.

commands.name: Add-OfficeMarkdownTableOfContents
commands.synopsis: Adds a table of contents for the document, the previous heading or a named section.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.notes: Here (default), Top or PreviousHeading.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.notes: Here (default), Top or PreviousHeading.

commands.notes: DSL content command: inside New-/Open-OfficeMarkdown it writes to the enclosing document; the Document set appends to a document passed explicitly or from the pipeline. -PassThru returns the document. No ShouldProcess. -PlaceAtTop/-ForPreviousHeading/-ForSection were mutually exclusive at run time; they become -Placement and a separate -Section set.

commands.name: Get-OfficeMarkdownHeading
commands.synopsis: Lists headings with level, text, anchor and position.

commands.name: Get-OfficeMarkdownTable
commands.synopsis: Returns tables as table blocks, or their rows as objects with -AsObject.

commands.name: Get-OfficeMarkdownFrontMatter
commands.synopsis: Returns front matter entries, optionally filtered by key.

commands.name: Get-OfficeMarkdownNode
commands.synopsis: Walks the Markdown syntax tree and returns node records or raw nodes.

commands.name: ConvertTo-OfficeMarkdown
commands.synopsis: Converts pipeline objects to a Markdown table string.
commands.notes: Object-to-text conversion, like ConvertTo-Html; stays a ConvertTo- command.

commands.name: New-OfficeRtf
commands.synopsis: Creates an RTF document, optionally with paragraphs from -Text or the pipeline.
commands.notes: -Text (or piped strings) is RTF's content: in the Text set -Path is required and the file is written when input ends. The Live set (no -Text, -Path optional) returns the live RtfDocument for Save-OfficeRtf [-Path] (replaces -NoSave). Refuses an existing file unless -Force. RTF keeps its paragraph-list authoring; no DSL is added (Tier 2).

commands.name: Open-OfficeRtf
commands.synopsis: Reads an RTF file or RTF text into a read result with the document, embedded payloads and diagnostics.
commands.notes: No content block: RTF has no PowerShell DSL. The result's Document can be passed to Save-OfficeRtf; lossless in-place edits stay on Update-OfficeRtfText.

commands.name: Save-OfficeRtf
commands.synopsis: Saves an RtfDocument to its original path or to a new path.
commands.notes: Needed by the lifecycle now that New-OfficeRtf without -Text returns a live document. Also accepts the Document of an Open-OfficeRtf result.

commands.name: Close-OfficeRtf
commands.synopsis: Releases an RtfDocument without saving.
commands.notes: Lifecycle parity; RtfDocument holds no file handle.

commands.name: Update-OfficeRtfText
commands.synopsis: Edits an RTF file losslessly: replaces text, appends paragraphs and sets document properties and variables.
commands.notes: -OldText and -NewText are given together; the existing check stays because both are optional alongside the property edits.

commands.name: New-OfficeRtfPdfOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates RTF-to-PDF options for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Pdf.
commands.notes: Images, metadata, tables, headers/footers and notes are on by default and turned off with -No switches. Default image sizes are lengths (bare number = points, as before).

commands.name: New-OfficeRtfHtmlOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates RTF-to-HTML options for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Html.
commands.notes: RTF reaches HTML through Word; these are the HTML settings of the former ConvertFrom-OfficeRtf -As Html.

commands.name: New-OfficeRtfMarkdownOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates RTF-to-Markdown options for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Markdown.

commands.name: New-OfficeHtmlRtfOptions
commands.synopsis: Creates HTML-to-RTF options for Convert-OfficeDocument -To Rtf.
commands.notes: Carries the HTML-specific settings of the former ConvertTo-OfficeRtf -Html/-HtmlPath sets.

commands.name: New-OfficeOpenDocument
commands.synopsis: Creates an OpenDocument text, spreadsheet, presentation or drawing (.odt, .ods, .odp, .odg), optionally from a content block.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.notes: Inferred from the -Path extension; give it only to check the extension.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.notes: Required when -Path is omitted; otherwise inferred from the extension.

commands.notes: Content set: -Path required, the block runs and the package is saved. Live set: no block, -Path optional; returns the live document for Save-OfficeOpenDocument [-Path]. -Kind is inferred from the extension when a path is given, -NoSave is removed and -Force is required to replace a file.

commands.name: Open-OfficeOpenDocument
commands.synopsis: Opens an OpenDocument package (ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, flat XML), optionally editing it in a content block.
commands.notes: Returns OdtDocument, OdsDocument, OdpPresentation or OdgDocument. -Password takes a SecureString; argument transformation also accepts a plain string (with a warning) or a PSCredential (its password). Package limits stay as parameters for untrusted input.

commands.name: Save-OfficeOpenDocument
commands.synopsis: Saves an OpenDocument document to its original path or to a new path.
commands.notes: -Path is optional for documents from New-/Open-. -PassThru returns the save result with its loss report.

commands.name: Close-OfficeOpenDocument
commands.synopsis: Releases an OpenDocument document without saving.
commands.notes: Lifecycle parity with the other authoring formats.

commands.name: Add-OfficeOpenDocumentHeading
commands.synopsis: Adds a heading to an OpenDocument text document.
commands.notes: DSL content command inside New-/Open-OfficeOpenDocument; outside a block pass the target object with -Document/-Sheet/-Slide or the pipeline. No ShouldProcess.

commands.name: Add-OfficeOpenDocumentParagraph
commands.synopsis: Adds a paragraph to an OpenDocument text document.
commands.notes: DSL content command inside New-/Open-OfficeOpenDocument; outside a block pass the target object with -Document/-Sheet/-Slide or the pipeline. No ShouldProcess.

commands.name: Add-OfficeOpenDocumentSheet
commands.synopsis: Adds a sheet to an OpenDocument spreadsheet; its content block holds OpenDocumentCell commands.
commands.notes: DSL content command inside New-/Open-OfficeOpenDocument; outside a block pass the target object with -Document/-Sheet/-Slide or the pipeline. No ShouldProcess.

commands.name: Add-OfficeOpenDocumentSlide
commands.synopsis: Adds a slide to an OpenDocument presentation; its content block holds OpenDocumentTextBox commands.
commands.notes: DSL content command inside New-/Open-OfficeOpenDocument; outside a block pass the target object with -Document/-Sheet/-Slide or the pipeline. No ShouldProcess.

commands.name: Add-OfficeOpenDocumentTextBox
commands.synopsis: Adds a positioned text box to an OpenDocument slide.
commands.notes: DSL content command inside New-/Open-OfficeOpenDocument; outside a block pass the target object with -Document/-Sheet/-Slide or the pipeline. No ShouldProcess. Geometry was in centimeters; it now takes lengths, so a bare number means points. Defaults stay 1cm, 1cm, 20cm x 3cm.

commands.name: Set-OfficeOpenDocumentCell
commands.synopsis: Sets a typed value in an OpenDocument spreadsheet cell (1-based row and column).
commands.notes: DSL content command inside New-/Open-OfficeOpenDocument; outside a block pass the target object with -Document/-Sheet/-Slide or the pipeline. No ShouldProcess. -Row and -Column are 1-based (were 0-based), matching how Office numbers rows and columns. -Sheet here is the sheet object from Add-OfficeOpenDocumentSheet; name/index selection is not offered because the command works inside a sheet block.

commands.name: New-OfficeEpub
commands.synopsis: Creates an EPUB publication, optionally filling it from a content block.
commands.notes: Gains the lifecycle shape: a content block of EpubChapter/EpubResource commands that saves when it ends (-Path required; fails on loss unless -AllowLoss, like Save-OfficeEpub), and -Force. Without a block (-Path optional) it returns the live publication for Save-OfficeEpub, as before.

commands.name: Open-OfficeEpub
commands.synopsis: Opens an EPUB publication, optionally editing it in a content block.
commands.notes: With a content block the publication is saved back when the block ends; that save fails on loss unless -AllowLoss.

commands.name: Save-OfficeEpub
commands.synopsis: Saves an EPUB publication to its original path or to a new path.
commands.notes: A native save keeps today's strictness: it fails if content would be lost, and -AllowLoss accepts the loss. -PassThru returns the write report, replacing -ReportVariable. Save- replaces the target like every Save-; -WhatIf/-Confirm protect it.

commands.name: Close-OfficeEpub
commands.synopsis: Releases an EPUB publication without saving.
commands.notes: Lifecycle parity.

commands.name: Add-OfficeEpubChapter
commands.synopsis: Adds a chapter from plain text, XHTML or Markdown.
commands.notes: DSL content command inside New-/Open-OfficeEpub; outside a block pass -Document or pipe the publication.

commands.name: Add-OfficeEpubResource
commands.synopsis: Adds a file (image, font, stylesheet) to the publication manifest.
commands.notes: DSL content command inside New-/Open-OfficeEpub.

commands.name: Get-OfficeEpubChapter
commands.synopsis: Returns the chapters of a publication in reading order.

commands.name: Set-OfficeEpubMetadata
commands.synopsis: Sets publication title, language and author.

commands.name: Open-OfficeAsciiDoc
commands.synopsis: Parses a AsciiDoc file or text into a OfficeIMO.AsciiDoc.AsciiDocDocument.
commands.notes: -AsResult returns the parse result with diagnostics. No content block or New-: PSWriteOffice has no DSL for this format; documents are edited through the object model and written with Save-.

commands.name: Save-OfficeAsciiDoc
commands.synopsis: Writes a OfficeIMO.AsciiDoc.AsciiDocDocument to a file.
commands.notes: -Path is optional for a document opened from a file.

commands.name: Open-OfficeLatex
commands.synopsis: Parses a Latex file or text into a OfficeIMO.Latex.LatexDocument.
commands.notes: -AsResult returns the parse result with diagnostics. No content block or New-: PSWriteOffice has no DSL for this format; documents are edited through the object model and written with Save-.

commands.name: Save-OfficeLatex
commands.synopsis: Writes a OfficeIMO.Latex.LatexDocument to a file.
commands.notes: -Path is optional for a document opened from a file.

commands.name: Open-OfficeIWork
commands.synopsis: Opens a Pages, Numbers or Keynote file as a read-only source document.
commands.notes: Read-only: iWork files are converted, not saved, so there is no New-/Save-/Close-.

commands.name: Open-OfficeOneNote
commands.synopsis: Opens a OneNote section (.one) or notebook as a read-only model.
commands.notes: Read-only model; OneNote output goes through Convert-OfficeDocument.

File conversion: Pages/Numbers/Keynote to DOCX/XLSX/PPTX through Convert-OfficeDocument -To Word|Excel|PowerPoint. It always returns the conversion report, so -PassThruReport goes; it replaces outputs by default with -NoClobber to refuse, so -Force goes. IWorkReadOptions and IWorkConversionOptions pass through -Options.
File conversion: OneNote to Markdown, HTML or PDF through Convert-OfficeDocument -To Markdown|Html|Pdf; the report is always returned; reader/projection/HTML/PDF option objects pass through -Options.
Output switches became -As; -DelimiterText merged into a string -Delimiter; bool parameters became switches; path aliases removed (LiteralPath keeps PSPath/FullName).
Loading a CsvDocument is one output mode of reading CSV; the five CSV commands become Import/Export/ConvertTo-OfficeCsv.
Parsing CSV text is Import-OfficeCsv with -Text. -Text is no longer bound from the pipeline because piped strings bind to -Path; pass the text with -Text.
Path synonyms and the NoOverwrite alias removed; -DelimiterText merged into a string -Delimiter.
-DelimiterText merged into a string -Delimiter.

On-by-default switch becomes -NoCssPageRules; viewport geometry becomes OfficeLength; color becomes OfficeColor; pixel-count limits are named ...PixelCount.
-Margin takes a length; the bool? form-controls parameter (default on) becomes -NoInteractiveFormControls.
-EncodingName shortened to -Encoding, the name Import-/Export-OfficeCsv use.

One image-export command for every format. HTML strings use -Text -From Html, an HtmlConversionDocument the -Document set; New-OfficeHtmlRenderOptions and New-OfficeHtmlConversionOptions pass through -Options. -PageIndex (0-based) becomes the shared 1-based -Page; the result object is always returned, so -PassThru goes.

Table cells take the same Text children in their content block.
